gameName: This War of Mine: The Board Game

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms)
This War of Mine: Tales from the Ruined City rulebook
This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook

steps.text: Board in the middle of the table (the back is a smaller, harder Shelter)
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Events deck, unseen, from the bottom: 3 shuffled Ending Events, Chapter III, 4 random Events, Chapter II, 3 random Events, Chapter I on top
steps.note: Unused Event cards go in the Waste bag
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Hard mode: 1 more Event card in Chapter I and in Chapter II
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Raising Game Difficulty

steps.text: Hardcore mode: 2 more Event cards in Chapter I and in Chapter II
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Raising Game Difficulty

steps.text: Shuffle the 13 new Location cards into the Locations deck
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, Other Game Components

steps.text: Locations: 3 cards on Far, Distant and Close at random; the rest shuffled on the Locations space
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Residents and Night Raids: set aside the 5 red-corner (!) cards of each; shuffle the rest onto their spaces
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Shuffle Exploration, Findings, Visitors, Characters, Fate, Narrative Actions and Colors decks onto their spaces; the Unknown space stays empty
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Shuffle the Tales cards (Chapter Objectives, Narrative Action and the rest) into their decks
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Tales from the Ruined City rulebook, Other Game Components

steps.text: Objectives deck: all Chapter Objectives and the Final Objective (Chapter I sorts them)
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Green-corner Fittings on the Fittings space; orange-corner ones as the Ideas deck
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: All Fitting cards on the Fittings space; there is no Ideas deck
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Back of the Board

steps.text: Shuffle the 19 Shelter cards blue-corner side down, unseen; each on the Shelter space with its name
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Furniture cards shuffled on the Furniture space, blue corner down; the other Shelter cards on their spaces, 2 Rubble stacked on the "2 x Rubble" space
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Back of the Board

steps.text: Combat dice, black die and Noise marker near the board; tokens and resources in their box compartments
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: On Storage: Lockpick, Shovel, {food} Raw Food, 4 Components, 4 Wood, 2 Water
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Remove the Events, Objectives and Fate decks; the Duty Narrative Action; every Reality Impact card; Soldiers and Rebels Residents; Central Square, Old Town and Sniper Junction Locations
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, War Campaign Setup

steps.text: Soldier Patrol into Exploration; the new Locations into Locations; War Fate on the Fate space; Story Characters by the board, 2-space track up
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, War Campaign Setup

steps.text: All Fitting cards (green and orange) on the Fittings space; no Ideas, no New Idea action
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, War Campaign Setup

steps.text: Pogoren Map beside the board, Shelter marker in District 10; Location markers: the big one covers the number by each Location space, the small one on the space
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, War Campaign Setup

steps.text: Pool of Exploration, Script, Completion, Favor and Airdrop tokens; Story tokens facedown beside the board
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, War Campaign Setup

steps.text: Plundered Old Town on the Map; the 9 Map Locations shuffled above it, 2 drawn under it with an Exploration token each; Special Locations deck facedown
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, War Campaign Setup

steps.text: Shuffle the rest as the Locations deck; reveal 1 on any Location space, roll for its District (10: re-roll), marker on the Map and an Exploration token on the card
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, War Campaign Setup

steps.text: Shelter (no Closed Doors): Bars on its space, 2 random Furniture and 1 random Heap on theirs, 2 Rubble; box the rest
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, War Campaign Setup

steps.text: Final Act Objective faceup on Objectives; 3 Soldiers on white discs by the Map; read Act I: Home and do its setup
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, War Campaign Setup

steps.text: From the Character deck keep the first red-bordered and the first 2 black-bordered cards
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Emira: shuffle her card into the Character deck before drawing; her miniature stays in the box until she appears
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Tales from the Ruined City rulebook, Emira

steps.text: Write their names on the Save Sheet
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Their figures (each in a coloured disk) on the Guard space; matching colour token by each card
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: A Hunger 2 token by each Character
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: Shuffle the other Character cards onto the Characters space
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup

steps.text: The Cat starts in the Shelter: its card and miniature
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Tales from the Ruined City rulebook, The Cat

steps.text: The Dog starts in the Shelter: its card and miniature
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, The Dog

steps.text: Desperate Measures: the 7 cards beside the board; they unlock once a Character dies or leaves
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Tales from the Ruined City rulebook, Desperate Measures

steps.text: Farmers: place the 2 Fitting cards from the module as their backs say; shuffle the other cards into their decks; Farmers and Thugs wait in the box
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Tales from the Ruined City rulebook, Farmers and Market

steps.text: Market: set it up as its sheet says (basic side of the board)
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Tales from the Ruined City rulebook, Farmers and Market

steps.text: Sewers: Rooms and Corridors decks facedown; the 8 Map tiles shuffled in a pile with the Starting Zone tile on top and the Exploring Party token beside it
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Tales from the Ruined City rulebook, Sewers

steps.text: Orphans of War: draw 1 Orphan card, its miniatures on any Shelter space, Happiness token on its track
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, Orphans of War

steps.text: Kid's Room Fitting placed as its back says; the other Kid Fittings into the Fittings deck; Kid Actions deck beside the board
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook, Orphans of War

steps.text: Never read a script in the Book of Scripts until the game sends you there
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), The Book of Scripts

steps.text: The Leader has the final word, after hearing everyone
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Shared Experience and the Leader

steps.text: Never more than 4 Characters in the group
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), The 4-Characters Limit

steps.text: Module scripts are in Wartime Diary I; never open the lettered envelopes until a Scenario says so
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Tales from the Ruined City rulebook, Envelopes

steps.text: Orphans of War and War Campaign scripts are in Wartime Diary II
steps.ref: This War of Mine: Days of the Siege rulebook

steps.text: Pick a random Leader; they take the first player miniature. Begin with the Morning phase
steps.ref: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms), Setup
